query: An SPF officer says my account is linked to money laundering and I must transfer everything to a safe account.
IRAS tax refund pending. Enter card details and OTP through this email link to receive the refund.
CPF verification officer asks for my Singpass password and SMS OTP to remove an account restriction.
Police investigation requires me to install an APK outside the app store and then transfer the call.
A text claims to be from a ministry but does not use the gov.sg SMS Sender ID and quotes my NRIC.
MOM email says my company breached the Employment Act and asks me to download compressed rectification documents.
Guaranteed 20 percent weekly crypto return with no risk, but the offer expires tonight.
The trading app shows a profit but requires a tax and verification fee before withdrawal.
The promoter says the broker is MAS regulated. I want to check the company and its licence before investing.
An online stranger added me to a Telegram investment group full of expert testimonials and success stories.
They paid a small early return, then asked for a much larger crypto transfer and now withdrawals are blocked.
Limited-time forex package promises high returns with almost no risk and a rebate if I deposit today.
Part-time work from home doing simple rating tasks. Pay a deposit to unlock commissions.
Recruitment screening requires my Singpass password and a QR-code scan before the interview.
The recruiter wants to use my personal bank account to receive and forward client funds for commission.
Earn money reviewing hotels, but use your own funds for each task before the commission is released.
A remote-job manager asks me to receive money and transfer it to other accounts for a fee.
A recruiter promises easy daily commission but says I must pay upfront before starting work.
Cancel the marketplace order and PayNow the seller directly outside platform checkout for a discount.
My parcel is held and the message wants an extra customs fee through a payment link.
The buyer sent a payment screenshot and wants me to release the item before funds appear in my account.
A marketplace buyer sent a QR code and asks for bank details and OTP to receive payment.
Seller says I must install a third-party app from a refund link to get my money back.
Very cheap limited deal but the seller refuses secure marketplace payment and demands a direct deposit.
Microsoft virus pop-up displays a support phone number and says my computer is compromised.
Unsolicited account alert asks me to click a link and enter my password, card details and OTP.
Bank SMS says an unauthorised transaction is pending and provides a login link to stop it.
Unexpected redelivery text says to use its link and enter card details for a small shipping fee.
I already transferred money to the account in the suspicious message. What should I do now?
I entered my email password and personal details after clicking the suspicious link.
I clicked the parcel link and entered my card details before noticing the address looked wrong.
I installed AnyDesk for the caller and allowed remote access to my computer and banking session.
